description: Default capability for the app's own windows: core IPC and the launcher's commands. `launcher` is the libraries screen (launcher-dist/index.html) — it is listed here because a window in no capability gets no IPC at all, and its every button is an `invoke` of one of main.rs's `launcher_*` commands. Its top bar is the title bar (main.rs `under_title_bar`), so it may also move and zoom the window. It is a LOCAL page, so unlike the other capability files it needs no `remote` block. build.rs declares the app's commands, so each is granted by name; with no `remote` block, none of them reaches the main window's page.
